records.subject: Welcome to Wrenfield, Ridge Analytics!
records.body:
Hi Rafael,

Thanks for setting up Ridge Analytics on Wrenfield. If your team is more than one person, inviting them now tends to pay off -- Wrenfield is built around teammates working on shared tasks, not solo lists.

Let me know how the first week goes.

Cheers,
Priya Chen

decisions.rationale: 6 days in, no first project and no key milestone despite one invite sent [email:dd7fc472]. Customer replied positively but low-engagement and deferring ("will reach out if anything comes up") [email:959950f7], no tickets, no stated use case. 8 days left; active Pro plan and a teammate present give some chance of self-serve activation.

draft.subject: Re: Anything I can help with?
draft.body:
Hi Rafael,

Thanks for the update — glad week one has felt good with another person in there.

One thing that tends to make the difference: in Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so getting that first project set up is where the shared work starts clicking. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project.

If it's easier, I'm happy to hop on a short call this week and help you get that first project shaped around real work your team is doing — just say the word.

Best,
Priya
